57.name: Pixel RGB
57.note: Pixel engine, RGB: 19 LEDs x 3, LEDs only, NO pan / tilt / zoom / dimmer (those live in the basic engine). A second engine with its own DMX address and universe (Set Up > Pixels Engine), switched on by the basic engine FUNCTION channel (value 103-105 = pixel map enabled), p22, p25.

76.name: Pixel RGBW
76.note: Pixel engine, RGBW: 19 LEDs x 4, LEDs only, no pan / tilt / zoom / dimmer. Second engine, own address, enabled from the basic engine FUNCTION channel 103-105, p22, p25.

111.name: Shapes + Pixel RGBW
111.note: The combined mode the Platina plan uses: the Shapes list (35) followed by the Pixel RGBW list (76). It is TWO ENGINES addressed side by side: patch the basic engine at address A and the pixel engine at A + 35 (own address and universe in the lamp's menu); channel 18 (FUNCTION) at 103-105 enables the pixel map. Not a single mode of the lamp: a patch convention built from two exact lists (manual p22, p25; the manual's own note on two engines).
